title: Hidden powers
blurb: Two secret trials that give your Pokémon a power, and what follows them.

rows.where: Route 112 (foot of Mt. Chimney, west side)
rows.what: A hidden cave into a sealed part of the Magma Hideout. Take TM53, then read the sign with a Typhlosion as your only Pokémon (nothing happens otherwise). Asked whether to leave, say No: Yes collapses the cave for good (0x42E2). The Crimson Apostle (a Flareon serving the Crimson Nova) then runs three rounds of hologram battles (trainers 1155-1157) and awakens the Burning Soul (0x4301); the cave collapses after that too. A lost round only blacks you out: the cave stays open and you start again from round 1. Needed for Ash's challenge. Lore: a Typhlosion trainer passed the same trial on Stark Mountain; Flint (Test of Heart) remembers a Johto girl's very fast Typhlosion.
Beat Koga (trainer 1160): he gives his mark and points to a hidden village through the forest of Route 102.
Elder Koga's succession trial: only one Greninja, some items banned, two stages (trainers 1159, 1158). Your Greninja gains its hero form, like Ash's.

With the Hero Greninja (0x4300), the Burning Soul (0x4301) and Team Rainbow Rocket beaten (0x41D5), say yes to your rival's battle in the lab: Ash walks in and you all go to Route 101 for a 2-vs-2, you and your rival against Ash and a red-haired passerby (-Echo-), who drops a cartridge and a note. Without all three it is the rival's usual battle.

The northeast corner of Steven's residence (its top room): -Echo- / -Hibiki- (trainer 1016), there only after Ash's challenge; talking to her counts, the battle is optional. A book there by Gengyi Xiang adds entries as you earn each power.

title: Area Zero
blurb: Extras of the Paldea area behind Mossdeep City's black hole; each is a row of the Quest Log's Side Content chapter.

rows.what: Play the professors' recorded log on the left counter of each station: No. 1 on the crater wall's middle ledge, No. 2 the house on the shelf below the stairs into the crater, No. 3 the house on the knoll in the east of the crater, No. 4 above the waterfall (surf across the pond and climb it). All four, then a word with Penny, unlock the Zero Lab's door

rows.where: Arven's picnic, by the big lake
rows.what: Beat the Titans in the den on the crater's west side - Great Tusk in the past, Iron Treads in the future - and bring Arven both Sour Herba Mystica: his sandwiches get Koraidon and Miraidon up again
After the story Nemona lives here: beat her in a rematch

After the story, behind the Crystal Cavern's second cave mouth: slide over the mirror floor and pull its three stakes, marked with a bundle of tablets (Wo-Chien), a vessel on three legs (Ting-Lu) and a string of curved beads (Chi-Yu); each frees the legend behind its crystal
A Booster Energy in an item ball in each era's crater
